trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Collapse & Oil Volatility
trends.summary: Iran-U.S. ceasefire deal deteriorating with both sides accusing violations, driving oil price swings and geopolitical uncertainty. Trump administration signaling readiness for military options if Iran develops nuclear weapons. Critical implications for energy markets and broader market risk sentiment.

trends.name: OpenAI IPO & Enterprise Revenue Growth
trends.summary: OpenAI CFO confirms IPO plans with retail investor allocations; enterprise revenue to reach parity with consumer segment by end of 2026. Major milestone in AI commercialization race signaling sustained growth trajectory and competitive positioning against Google/Meta.

trends.name: Meta AI Model Competition vs OpenAI/Google
trends.summary: Meta debuts new AI model after spending billions to catch up with OpenAI and Google. Represents escalating competition in generative AI race with significant capital deployment implications for big tech sector.

trends.name: Trump NATO Troop Reallocation Over Iran Support
trends.summary: Trump administration considering moving U.S. troops out of NATO countries deemed 'unhelpful' to Iran war effort, redeploying them to supportive allies. Major geopolitical shift with implications for alliance structure, defense contractors, and international stability.

trends.name: Retail Investor Risk Appetite Collapse
trends.summary: Daily net call option purchases by retail investors plunged to ~2 million contracts—lowest since January 2024—signaling sharp withdrawal from risk assets amid Iran conflict. Major shift in retail sentiment affecting equity demand and market breadth.

trends.name: Constellation Brands Demand Warnings & Tariff Shock
trends.summary: Corona/Modelo brewer withdraws 2028 guidance citing uncertainty, reports consumer shift to cheaper beer/wine, and faces tariff headwinds from Mexico. Combined signals of demand weakness and margin compression in beverages sector; beats on Q4 but cautious forward outlook.

trends.name: India Export Risk From Iran/Tariff Crisis
trends.summary: India's $100 billion garments export goal threatened by Iran conflict escalation and tariff uncertainty. Emerging market exposure to geopolitical disruption affecting supply chains and growth forecasts for Asian economies.

trends.name: Intel Stock Surge to 5-Year High
trends.summary: Intel stock rallies to five-year highs driven by semiconductor sector momentum and likely tech spending cycle strength. Suggests capital intensity of AI infrastructure buildout benefiting chipmakers alongside positive near-term technicals.

trends.name: Prediction Markets Explode; Kalshi Dominance
trends.summary: Kalshi prediction market platform captures 91% of U.S. prediction market share with surging weekly trading volume. Reflects shift in how investors price geopolitical/political events, particularly relevant given Iran/Trump policy uncertainty.

trends.name: Anthropic Pentagon Blacklist Appeal Fails
trends.summary: Anthropic loses appeals court bid to block Pentagon blacklisting, limiting defense/government AI contracts. Regulatory headwind for AI companies seeking public sector revenue and signals tightening restrictions on AI deployment.

trends.name: Energy Stocks Benefit From Oil Price Recovery
trends.summary: Oil prices resume gains on Iran ceasefire tensions; FCG and energy sector positioned for profit surge. Oil-linked hardware store stocks also rally. Geopolitical premium in energy markets creating tactical trading opportunities.

trends.name: Latin America Growth Slowdown; Mexico & Brazil Weak
trends.summary: World Bank forecasts subdued growth for Mexico (1.3-1.7%) and Brazil (1.6-1.8%) driven by subdued investment and policy uncertainty. Signals EM weakness; investment remains constrained as firms await clearer external/domestic policy signals.
